title: Review and Approval
meta: A simple approval workflow so a person checks every claim before marketing goes live. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Review and approval steps for safer marketing
overview: Fast content tools make it easy to publish something wrong. We set up a short review process so a person checks every claim before it goes out. We map who writes, who reviews and who approves, then build a checklist covering facts, prices, health or legal claims, image rights and platform rules. We set it up in the tools you already use, such as a shared sheet or board, and test it with three of your real pieces.

pkgs.blurb: A one page checklist and a simple approval flow.
A tracked workflow with roles, status board and claim log.
A full review system with training and a trial run.

faq: Prices, discounts, health and safety statements, comparisons with others, reviews and any numbers. We list the risky kinds for your industry, and you decide who has the final say.
